name: Residual path closure for Evolvable Validation Framework evidence
normal_intent: Evaluate a finite, declared path universe and preserve path-to-residue-to-obligation closure without strengthening provider evidence.
testable_candidate: Every reachable safety-relevant path has a stable identifier, an owned desired residue, at least one verification obligation, and current digest-bound evidence; every excluded path has a boundary rationale.
non_goals: publication, release, deployment, or external-effect authority
